plan.notes: SOURCE: Official Hostos Community College Academic Degree Map — 'COMPUTER SCIENCE / ASSOCIATE OF SCIENCE' (Office of Academic Affairs, Academic Advisement), dated 9/12/2022, 'updated for DEV-ED Spring 2023': https://hostos.cuny.edu/Hostos/media/Office-of-Academic-Affairs/Academic-Advisement/Computer-Science-AS-Degree-Map-updated-for-DEV-ED-Spring-2023-updated-9-12-2022.pdf — the currently published official term-by-term degree map for the AS in Computer Science on hostos.cuny.edu as of 2026-09-30 (no newer CS AS map found). CATALOG YEAR: 2022-2023 (map era matches the 2022-2023 College Catalog, whose p.198 'COMPUTER SCIENCE – A.S. – CUNY PATHWAYS' page corroborates the requirements: https://hostos.cuny.edu/Hostos/media/Downloadable-Files/2022-2023-College-Catalog-Hostos-Community-College_1.pdf). TRANSCRIPTION: transcribed term-by-term from the degree map's five sections (CREDITS COMPLETED 1-4 + SUMMER); titles, credits, and prereqs cross-checked against 2022-2023 catalog course descriptions. TOTAL CREDITS: the degree map prints TOTAL CREDITS 64 (term subtotals 14-15, 14-15, 16, 13; summer 3+4=7; 14+14+16+13+7=64 is the minimum path). The CUNY Pathways degree minimum is 60 credits — the sequence's own published total (64) is used here per the Clarkson/UVM/GCSU precedent. CREDIT RANGE: the catalog lists CSC 205 Discrete Mathematics at 4 credits (CSC 215 is 3); the 14-15 term subtotal reflects that choice — CSC 205/215 slots are modeled at 3 credits for the 64-credit path; choosing CSC 205 raises the total toward 66. CS SEQUENCE: the map requires 13-16 credits of Computer Science sequence (two 'CSC 205 or CSC 215' slots + two 'CSC 275 or CSC 300+ or CSC 375 or CSC 395' slots); e.g. CSC 205 (4) + CSC 215 (3) + two 300-level CSC courses (3+3) = 13. SUMMER: the map's summer section is untimed ('GET AHEAD! TAKE CLASSES DURING THE SUMMER'); modeled here as 'Summer Year 2' after semester 4; the summer subtotal is not printed on the map (7 = 64 minus 57). MILESTONES: the map marks major milestone courses 'that must be taken in sequential order'; two Writing Intensive courses are required for graduation. PLACEMENT: MAT 160 'if needed due to placement'; students who do not place into MAT 160 or higher take MAT 150 College Algebra with Trigonometric Functions (4 cr) as a free elective (listed in external_prereqs). CSC 215 also carries pre/corequisite ESL 35; ENG 110/111 carry developmental ENG/ESL placement requirements — see catalog. PREREQS (from 2022-2023 catalog course descriptions): MAT 210 requires MAT 160; MAT 220 requires MAT 210; MAT 217 Linear Algebra requires MAT 210 (corequisite MAT 220). Per-option prereqs for the CSC choice slots are documented in each slot's choice_note.
